faq.question: Q1. What is the KVAFSU Data Entry Operator recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: KVAFSU has invited applications for the post of Data Entry Operator under the National One Health Program for Prevention and Control of Zoonoses on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for KVAFSU Data Entry Operator recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Data Entry Operator post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application for KVAFSU Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the soft copy of the application via email is 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for KVAFSU Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree - B. Com, BCA, B.Sc, B.A or any other Bachelor degree from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KVAFSU Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be less than 35 years of age, with age relaxations up to 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What are the consolidated emoluments for the KVAFSU Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive consolidated emoluments of Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview scheduled for KVAFSU Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled for 23 October 2026 at 10.00 AM in the chamber of the Dean (Vety), Veterinary College, KVAFSU, Hebbal, Bengaluru - 560 024.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee for KVAFSU Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent employment opportunity?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is temporary, terminable at any time without assigning any reason, and candidates have no right to permanent employment in the University.
